lead.headline: Relativistic Hydrodynamics as an Intersection Problem
body: Ideal relativistic hydrodynamics admits a covariant description as an intersection problem in a symplectic space associated with spacetime. The independent fields are differential forms of degrees 0,1,3,4.

Spacetime diffeomorphisms and shifts of the momentum one-form act Hamiltonianly; the zero locus of their moment map is a coisotropic subvariety encoding the transport equations. The spacetime metric and equation of state determine a Lagrangian submanifold, whose intersection with the coisotropic subvariety is precisely the Lichnerowicz--Carter system.

We explain the geometric meaning of the canonical flow parameter, derive circulation and Ertel invariants directly from the constraints, and identify energy--momentum conservation with covariance of the constitutive Lagrangian.

features.headline: Wormholes do not contribute to supersymmetric partition functions
body: We show that wormholes connecting multiple asymptotic boundaries always spontaneously break at least some of the symmetries preserved by their boundary conditions. Their configurations then form nontrivial orbits of the broken symmetry, and for the case of a fermionic symmetry, the contribution of each orbit vanishes.
We conclude that wormholes do not contribute to moments of supersymmetric partition functions. This extends results on supersymmetric indices by Iliesiu, Kologlu, and Turiaci.

features.headline: Bring Your Own Instanton: Monopole Catalysis from Sourced SU(2) Instantons
body: We show that Rubakov-Callan catalysis of proton decay in the field of a 't Hooft-Polyakov monopole proceeds through "sourced SU(2) instantons", which are novel topological gauge configurations sourced by fermions and carrying unit instanton number. Unlike vacuum BPST instantons, these sourced instantons do not give rise to exponentially suppressed rates.
We relate the winding number to the number of fermionic zero modes, suggesting an underlying index theorem for sourced instantons.

features.headline: An all-orders proof of gradient flow for multiscalar $φ^4$ theory in four dimensions
body: We prove that the renormalisation group flow of multiscalar $φ^4$ theory in four dimensions is a gradient flow to all orders in perturbation theory. The proof uses the Weyl consistency conditions of Osborn and Jack, and it assumes two properties of perturbation theory: that the generating functional with local couplings is finite (also assumed by Osborn and Jack), and that the known expansion of massive Feynman integrals at large momenta holds with a bound on its remainder at each momentum.

stories.headline: Gradient formula from the sphere for perturbative RG flows near critical dimensions
body: We study the gradient property of perturbative renormalisation group flows in $d=d_c-\varepsilon$, with a potential and a metric regular at $\varepsilon=0$ up to logarithms of gauge couplings. We state properties of the renormalised functional with local couplings on the sphere $S^d$: finiteness, a local Weyl anomaly, the Ward identity of a conformal Killing vector, rotation properties and statements on the free theory.

stories.headline: The Generalized Second Law from Fluctuation Theorems in a Quantum Reference Frame
body: We prove the generalized second law (GSL) for black-hole exteriors undergoing unitary driving and relaxation on a fixed semifinite algebra. Wall's influential proof assumes semiclassical geometry and restricts fixed parent states to algebras of successive horizon cuts.

stories.headline: Lie Algebra Cohomology and Seiberg-Witten Theory
body: We compute the algebra of perturbative holomorphic-topological local operators of pure $\mathcal N=2$ gauge theory with gauge group $SU(2)$, proving a conjecture of the author: it is the Poisson vertex algebra generated by a Virasoro element $X$ of central charge zero and an odd primary $Y$ of weight three, subject only to $X^2=0$.

stories.headline: Non-invertible Duality Defects in Four-Dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_N$ Lattice Gauge Theories
body: We consider four-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_N$ lattice gauge theories with generalized plaquette actions. These theories are known to exhibit dualities.
We construct topological interfaces implementing these dualities by assigning a weight to each building block and proving topological invariance.

stories.headline: Conservative tidal effects to third post-Minkowskian order in scalar-tensor theories
body: Using worldline effective field theory, we compute the conservative finite-size contributions to the impulse and scattering angle of nonspinning compact binaries in massless scalar-tensor theories with a scalar-Gauss-Bonnet coupling through third post-Minkowskian (3PM) order.

stories.headline: Scattering amplitudes in AdS$_5\times$ S$^5$ from the pure spinor superstring
body: We formulate a BRST-invariant prescription for the integration of zero modes in the pure spinor superstring on $AdS_5\times S^5$. The measure includes contributions absent in flat space and admits a description in terms of picture changing operators or a non-minimal regulator.

stories.headline: Bounds on entanglement fluctuations at holographic interfaces
body: How small can entanglement fluctuations be at fixed entropy? For a class of holographic conformal interfaces supported by a scalar with a potential, we prove $c_\text{eff}\leq c_\text{cap}\leq c_\text{eff}^2/c_{LR}$, relating entropy, capacity, and energy transmission.

stories.headline: Matter-decorated trumpets in double-scaled SYK
body: In sine-dilaton gravity, the double trumpet, the wormhole amplitude without matter, is obtained by gluing two trumpets along a closed geodesic of discrete length and summing over this length. When the wormhole carries the propagator of a matter field of dimension $Δ$, joining the two asymptotic boundaries and crossing the neck, such a gluing is known only in the Jackiw--Teitelboim (JT) limit.

sections.name: Across the Border
sections.note: Papers whose primary category is not hep-th (mostly gr-qc), cross-listed into it

stories.headline: Analytic $k$-essence Inflation
body: In this work we develop a fully analytic $k$-essence inflation solution which is compatible with the observational constraints on inflation, without the need for the slow-roll assumption being imposed dynamically in the field equations. The analytic solution is obtained for a kinetic scalar sector of the form $K(X)= \frac{X^n}{X_s^{n-1}}$ and for the scalar field satisfying a tracking condition $\dotφ^2=γH^{-m}$.

stories.headline: Imprints of quantum space in the ringdown phase of Kerr black holes
body: We investigate quantum-space corrections to the gravitational quasinormal modes (QNMs) of Kerr black holes within the framework of noncommutative geometry. The analysis employs a pseudo-semi-Killing Drinfeld twist, which preserves the classical Kerr geometry as an exact background solution while introducing nontrivial quantum corrections to linearized gravitational perturbations.

stories.headline: Unruh-like effects and correlation harvesting between particle detectors in uniform motion in (2+1)-dimensional Minkowski spacetime
body: We study Gaussian-switched Unruh-DeWitt detectors coupled to a massless scalar field in the (2+1)-dimensional Minkowski vacuum and following four classes of uniformly accelerated trajectories: linear, catenary, cusped, and circular motion. We first determine how the single-detector transition probability and effective temperature depend on acceleration and the torsion-to-acceleration ratio $\bar{b}$, whose continuous variation connects these four trajectory classes.

briefs.headline: Boundary spectroscopy of hidden near-horizon reflection
briefs.text: A classical black hole horizon absorbs completely, and any deviation would be hidden in the bulk.

briefs.headline: Infrared finite scattering theory: Non-relativistic Coulomb scattering
briefs.text: We revisit non-relativistic quantum-mechanical scattering in a Coulomb potential.

briefs.headline: The Gradient Structure of Perturbative RG Flows
briefs.text: Weyl consistency conditions show that perturbative renormalisation group flows in two, four and six dimensions are almost gradient flows.

briefs.headline: Anti-de Sitter charges and maximal Cauchy hypersurfaces
briefs.text: We construct conserved charges of asymptotic symmetries for negative-cosmological-constant vacuum spacetimes from the Neumann data for the Hamiltonian and momentum constraints on maximal conformally-compact Cauchy hypersurfaces. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Nonabelianization map for the $W_{3,c=2}$ conformal blocks. Part I
briefs.text: This work is inspired by the nonabelianization construction of Virasoro conformal blocks.

briefs.headline: Massive de Sitter correlators at one loop
briefs.text: Fermions and massive fields charged under an unbroken symmetry couple to the inflaton only in pairs, so their signals in primordial correlators begin at one loop.

briefs.headline: Darboux transformation for the ASDYM equations: Solitons and instantons
briefs.text: Using a one-fold Darboux transformation for the anti-self-dual Yang--Mills equations, we express the Yang--Mills Lagrangian density in terms of $τ$-functions.

briefs.headline: Quadratic-in-spin scattering of compact bodies at fourth post-Minkowskian order
briefs.text: We present the fourth-post-Minkowskian scattering angle of aligned spinning compact bodies through quadratic spin at arbitrary velocity and mass ratio.
briefs.authors: Taushif Ahmed and Syed Mehedi Hasan

briefs.headline: Thermodynamics of hard wall model of AdS/QCD at finite chemical potential with Gauss-Bonnet corrections
briefs.text: We study the confinement/deconfinement transition of the hard wall model of AdS/QCD at finite quark density in five-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell--Gauss--Bonnet gravity, with the back-reaction of the quark matter on the geometry included.
briefs.authors: Dharm Veer Singh and Shobhit Sachan

briefs.headline: Massive Particles in Carrollian Holography
briefs.text: Understanding how massive particles are encoded in boundary operators is a central problem in Carrollian holography.

briefs.headline: Central charges as black-hole hair in weakly coupled trace-anomaly gravity
briefs.text: We study black holes in Gabadadze's weakly coupled effective theory of the gravitational trace anomaly, keeping both the Euler and the Weyl central charges. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Dissipative Tidal Love Numbers of Neutron Stars from Viscous Heating
briefs.text: We compute the leading low-frequency dissipative tidal response of nonrotating relativistic neutron stars. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Electromagnetic Memory as a Collider Observable
briefs.text: Electromagnetic memory and charge correlators are measured by different detectors, sensitive to soft radiation and to hard charged tracks.

briefs.headline: Near-boundary and near-horizon momentum--Krylov response in noncommutative-inspired BTZ spacetime
briefs.text: We compute the proper radial momentum of a massive probe falling into a Lorentzian-smeared, noncommutative-inspired BTZ black hole at fixed asymptotic mass, and use it as the growth rate of momentum--Krylov complexity.

briefs.headline: Dirichlet walls beyond JT gravity and their quantum group interpretation
briefs.text: We canonically quantize sinh dilaton gravity with finite Dirichlet boundary conditions.

briefs.headline: Rotating Black Holes from Scaling Transformations in Horava Gravity
briefs.text: We study the scaling transformations that change the physical parameters of solutions in low-energy Horava gravity.
briefs.authors: Deniz O. Devecioglu and Mu-In Park

briefs.headline: Exact stress-tensor fluctuations from conformal symmetry and black hole radiation
briefs.text: Semiclassical gravity is sourced by the expectation value of the stress tensor, and it is reliable only if the fluctuations around this value are small.

briefs.headline: Void inside the horizon: connecting the third-quantized vacuum to a classical spacetime
briefs.text: We investigate the emergence of a classical spacetime from a quantum-gravitational vacuum within the framework of third quantization applied to the black hole interior. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Tensionless M5-brane in light-cone gauge. The spinor moving frame method is wanted
briefs.text: We perform the complete light-cone gauge fixing for the tensionless limit of the M-theory 5-brane the action for which was recently obtained in [1].

briefs.headline: Charged spin-$\frac32$ in a chiral Feshbach--Villars model: hyperbolic propagation, Landau-level instability, and exceptional points
briefs.text: We study a Pauli-coupled second-order wave equation on $(\frac32,0)\oplus(0,\frac32)$ with a free gyromagnetic ratio $g$.

briefs.headline: A note on Holographic Renormalization for Polarized IKKT
briefs.text: We construct a boundary counterterm for the on-shell action of type IIB supergravity solutions dual to vacua of the polarized IKKT matrix model.

briefs.headline: Symmetry resolved spread complexity for BMN matrix model
briefs.text: We investigate the symmetry-resolved spread complexity of the Berenstein-Maldacena-Nastase (BMN) matrix model under a global $U(1)$ symmetry acting within the transverse $SO(6)$ scalar sector.

briefs.headline: Finite-Temperature Stabilization of a KKLT Modulus in Three-Dimensional Lattice Simulations
briefs.text: We investigate the cosmological stabilization of a KKLT modulus through three-dimensional Langevin lattice simulations incorporating an evolving thermal bath, dissipation, spatial gradients, and stochastic fluctuations.

briefs.headline: The type-II double copy for relativistic Rindler fluids
briefs.text: Within the Weyl double copy framework, we study a mixed single-copy construction for the Petrov type-II geometry of first-order relativistic Rindler fluids. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: The chiral $M^{3,2}$ theory: partition functions beyond large-$N$ and quantum holography
briefs.text: We identify families of Bethe vacua in the chiral $M^{3,2}$ theory whose individual free energies grow as $N^{3/2}$.
